blocks.text: For 70 years, the People Management Association of the Philippines (PMAP) has remained committed to shaping and advancing the people management landscape in the country. At this year’s Annual Conference, this legacy takes the center stage as PMAP prepares and guides its attendees towards the future of the industry. PMAP’s 63rd Annual Conference is set to commence on October 21-23 at the Marriott Grand Ballroom in Pasay City. As the country’s premier people management gathering, the event brings together influential business leaders, human resources (HR) practitioners, and global thought leaders for three days of conversation, collaboration, and practical exploration of the […]...
